[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Jump game II** [LC 45 · Jump Game II](https://leetcode.com/problems/jump-game-ii/){difficulty="Medium"}

"Always jump as far as you can" takes 3 jumps on `[2,3,1,1,4]` ($0 \to 2 \to 3 \to 4$) and gets stuck on `[2,3,0,1,4]`. A long jump can land on a dead cell. What matters is the farthest index the **next** jump can reach, and that is exactly the end of the next BFS layer.

[Solved in full in @sec-od-p4-jump2.]{.card-link}
